title: Gritin Reading Lamp with Clip — 19 LEDs, 3 Colour Temperatures, USB
short_description: A USB-rechargeable clip-on reading lamp with 19 LEDs, 3 colour temperature modes and stepless brightness. Flexible 360° neck for book, tablet or bed.
long_description: The Gritin reading lamp clips onto a book, tablet, shelf or bed frame and lights the pages precisely. It offers 19 LEDs, three colour temperature modes (cool white, warm white, mixed) and stepless brightness. The built-in battery charges via USB, and the 360° flexible gooseneck adjusts freely. Compact and light — ideal for long reading on dark evenings, while travelling or in bed.
buying_angle: Practical for anyone who reads in bed, while travelling or on the sofa and wants focused, eye-friendly light without a big lamp.
